metadata.title: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner - Review Questions
metadata.purpose: Expandable questionnaire. User answers and book answers can be added later.
notes: Questions are transcribed from the supplied review-question screenshots.
Questions/options whose book answer was not visible in the supplied answer-key screenshots keep book_answer as null rather than being guessed.
For multiple-choice questions, answers are stored as strings for single-answer questions and comma-separated strings for multiple-answer questions.
metadata.answer_key_status: Updated with the supplied answer-key pages; Chapter 7 questions 12-20 remain null because their corresponding answer-key text was not visible in the supplied pages.
